text:
sara (product): Quick sync — we need to lock down acceptance criteria for the enterprise compliance push (audit logs, tenant retention, BYO keys, SOC2/ISO evidence exports). Customer asks are piling up; want a clear MVP for Q2. 

mike (security): +1. Priority: tamper-evident audit logs, tenant-scoped retention controls, and an auditable BYOK handoff. Also need key-rotation and escrow policies documented. :lock:

nina (eng-infra): Implementation note — per-tenant retention and searchable audit indexes will increase storage and query cost. Propose retention tiers (90d / 1y / 7y) and an index-sampling mode for long tails to reduce cost.

oliver (solutions): For onboarding, customers expect an API they can call to set retention and KMS details. Example payload idea: 

```json
POST /v1/tenants/123/retention
{
  "retention_days": 365,
  "audit_export_format": "ndjson",
  "kms_provider": "aws-kms",
  "kms_key_id": "arn:aws:kms:...:key/abcd",
  "legal_hold": false
}
```

sara (product): Good, Nina — can you sketch cost delta for 90d vs 1y vs 7y index+raw-store by EOD Friday? We need numbers for pricing packaging.

nina (eng-infra): Will do. Quick ask: are we ok with separate storage buckets per-tenant for retention enforcement? That's simplest for deletion semantics.

mike (security): Separate buckets per-tenant is fine, but we need server-side encryption + integrity checks and a write-once pattern for logs until TTL expiry. Also audit manifest with SHA256 per export.

jess (legal): From legal view: evidence export needs chain-of-custody metadata + timestamped signature and a retention-change audit trail. Customers doing e-discovery will require preservation flags (legal_hold true).

sara (product): Ok tentative decision for MVP: 
- Default retention: 90 days.
- Self-serve upgrades: 1 year and 7 year tiers (paid).
- API to set per-tenant retention + legal_hold flag.
- Audit export format: NDJSON with signed manifest.
- BYOK: initial support for AWS KMS / GCP KMS, key id stored only as reference; encryption happens in customer-controlled KMS (we store ciphertext).

mike (security): Add: BYOK onboarding handshake must include proof of key policy allowing decrypt for our service principal and rotation window rules. Escrow only for enterprise with signed contract — don't enable escrow by default.

oliver (solutions): From SE calls: customers want a preview export tool in Console and a dry-run API to validate retention rules before committing. Could be a small UI deliverable for launch.

sara (product): Launch criteria checklist draft: 
- Feature parity: API + Console to set retention and legal_hold.
- Security: KMS integrations (AWS/GCP), key policy validation, encryption-at-rest + integrity.
- Ops: per-tenant deletion job with audit logs, SLA for export generation <= 2h for <= 10GB.
- Compliance: signed NDJSON manifest and chain-of-custody docs for SOC2 evidence pack.

mike (security): SLA note: 2h for 10GB seems reasonable as an initial SLO. We'll need a runbook for large exports ( >100GB ).

nina (eng-infra): Ops concern: long exports will tie resources — propose a background job with staged streaming and pre-signed link to storage. That also solves bandwidth spikes.

sara (product): Decision time: target MVP scope = retention API + console UI, AWS/GCP BYOK initial support, signed NDJSON export, basic legal_hold. No escrow or PCI-level on-prem key escrow for MVP.

jess (legal): Agreed as long as escrow is clearly documented as an enterprise-only add-on and customers sign the escrow TOS.

oliver (solutions): I'll draft an SE-facing onboarding checklist and a sample contract clause for escrow customers.

sara (product): Action items and owners: 
- Nina: cost delta (90d/1y/7y) + storage design (due Fri)
- Mike: BYOK policy checklist + key policy validation spec (due Tue)
- Oliver: SE onboarding checklist + sample API payloads + Console preview mockups (due next Wed)
- Jess: legal_hold wording + escrow TOS draft (due next Wed)
- Me (sara): tie-in pricing tiers and finalize launch criteria doc (due next Thu)

sara (product): Can we schedule a 30m follow-up Wed 9am PT to review mocks and cost numbers? @nina @mike @oliver @jess

ci-bot: Reminder: create RFC ticket RFC-2026-034 for "tenant-retention-byo-keys" and link this thread.

mike (security): One more: add monitoring/eventing to Console — alert when retention policy changes and when KMS key rotates. That should be in the acceptance criteria.

sara (product): Added. Thanks everyone. If no objections I’ll mark MVP scope and start comms to sales/solutions. :thumbsup:

oliver (solutions): No objections from me. Will start drafting SE playbook.

nina (eng-infra): No objections. Will post cost numbers on the RFC when ready.

jess (legal): No objections.

mike (security): 👍

sara (product): Closing thread — will update RFC and ping again when drafts are ready.
